title: Cycling Workout Generator — Engine Data Schema
description: LEAN schema (decision 2a): defines the STRUCTURE of the domain and the HARD, INVIOLABLE RULES only. It deliberately does NOT contain a lookup table of prescribed physiological values (e.g. 'Tempo = 3-4 reps x 10-20min'). Those concrete values are reasoned by the engine (deterministic Python core + Claude reasoning/web-search layer), grounded in external reference material (the athlete's stimulus matrix + peer-reviewed literature) that lives OUTSIDE this schema. See spec Sections 9.5, 3, 7.1.

powerZoneName.description: Friel preset power zones (spec 4.1). Fixed data — genuinely fixed, so it belongs here. SweetSpot is an overlay, not a sequential zone.

hrZoneName.description: Friel preset HR zones (spec 4.2), anchored to LTHR only. NEVER cross-correlated with power zones (spec 4 critical rule).

mode.description: Generation mode. Power is primary/default; HR is secondary (LTHR-anchored). A single request is one mode only — the two zone systems are never mixed (spec 4).

percentRange.description: An intensity range as integer percents. For power: % of FTP. For HR: % of LTHR. Output is ALWAYS a range, never a single value, and ALWAYS percentage-based — never absolute watts/bpm (spec 4.3). low<=high.

rpeRange.description: RPE on Borg CR10 (1-10), ALWAYS a range (spec 6.1). Derivation: flat segment -> midpoint of %range -> zone -> band from spec 6.2; ramp segment -> floor of lower endpoint's band to ceiling of upper endpoint's band (spec 6.3). Single-value only as [1,1] or [10,10].

cadenceRange.description: Optional cadence target in rpm, appearing after the intensity target and before RPE in the grammar (spec 12.2). May be a single value (low==high) or a range. Drills are out of scope (spec 14) — cadence here is only a target modifier, never a skill drill.

segmentRole.description: What role a single step plays. 'rest' segments ALWAYS carry an explicit % target — never undefined 'easy'/'coast' (spec 10). Since v0.6.0 (spec 11, v2.7) the warmup and cooldown are designed per session; there is no fixed prep block.

step.description: A single workout line. Resolves to the intervals.icu grammar: duration -> target -> [cadence] -> [RPE] (spec 12.2). Distance targets, freeride, %HR-vs-maxHR, and %Pace are FORBIDDEN and rejected by the output-validation gate (spec 12.3 / 14).

duration_seconds.description: Time-based only (this project never uses distance, spec 12.2). Integer seconds; rounding to valid syntax happens at render time (spec 16.4).

is_ramp.description: True if this step is a gradual ramp (target has distinct start/end). Ramps use the endpoint-span RPE rule (spec 6.3).

intensity.description: For a flat step: a single percentRange. For a ramp: see intensity_ramp instead. One of intensity / intensity_ramp must be present.

intensity_ramp.description: For a ramp step only: the start and end of the gradual change. start may be lower (ascending) or higher (descending) than end.

rendering.description: The exact, literally-valid intervals.icu syntax line this step compiles to (spec 12.2). This is what gets written to the .md file. MUST pass the output-validation gate (spec 12.3).

allOf.description: Exactly one of flat intensity or ramp must be provided.

repeatBlock.description: A repeated set of steps. Maps to intervals.icu 'Nx' repeat syntax. NESTED REPEATS ARE FORBIDDEN (spec 12.2) — a block's steps must all be plain steps, never another repeatBlock. Divided/split patterns are expressed as multiple sequential repeatBlocks, never nesting.

sectionElement.description: An element of a session section: either a single step or a (non-nested) repeat block.

structuralPatternCategory.description: The expressible structural pattern CATEGORIES (spec 8). These are rule-FORMS, not value tables. 'cluster_sets' is deliberately absent (removed in review M2 as unsupported). The engine may enrich within the dominant/subordinate boundary (spec 17).

generationRequest.title: GenerationRequest
generationRequest.description: What the user asks the engine to produce. The engine OBEYS (spec 3). Any parameter the user fixes is sacred and outside the scope of anti-repetition variation (spec 17).

requested_zone_power.description: Present only for power-mode requests where the user fixed a zone.

requested_zone_hr.description: Present only for hr-mode requests where the user fixed a zone.

target_duration_seconds.description: Requested total session duration, if specified.

max_available_seconds.description: Hard upper bound on session duration (spec 3). May conflict with target_tss/target_if -> infeasibility report, engine never silently picks which to sacrifice (spec 16.3).

target_tss.description: Optional target Load. Engine resolves via spec 16 algebra. Reported value is the design-time estimate of the ROUNDED workout, not authoritative (spec 16.2/16.4).

target_if.description: Optional target Intensity Factor. Power-mode concept; behavior in hr-mode is engine-reasoned (G4), not a fixed rule here.

athlete.description: All optional, graceful degradation (spec 5). Internal-only; NEVER converted to absolute watts/bpm in output (spec 4.3).

cp_watts.description: Power anchor value = CP (spec 7.2.3). Used only internally for the W'bal sim. 'FTP' is just its display label.

w_prime_joules.description: W' in joules. If absent, CP/W' model does not run; engine relies on physiological foundation (spec 7.1).

lthr_bpm.description: Internal-only LTHR. Independent of the power anchor.

progression.description: Required when kind=progression. The load:recovery ratio is user-specified; ramp-between-load-weeks and recovery-week-reduction are REQUIRED explicit params — engine never invents them (spec 15). Missing -> request flagged incomplete.

load_to_recovery_ratio.description: e.g. '2:1', '3:1', '4:1' (spec 15). Engine cycles the pattern across total_weeks.

recovery_week_reduction.description: REQUIRED explicit coaching parameter — what a recovery week reduces. Engine never defaults this (spec 15).

load_week_ramp.description: OPTIONAL explicit coaching parameter. If absent, engine does NOT ramp — repeats requested session(s) unchanged across load weeks (spec 15). Engine never invents a ramp rate.

generatedSession.title: GeneratedSession
generatedSession.description: One fully-rendered session the engine produces. ALWAYS has mandatory Warmup + Main Set + Cooldown (spec 11). Logged to SQLite for anti-repetition (spec 17).

generation_seed.description: Random seed used, for reproducibility/audit (spec design note).

progression_id.description: Nullable. Links sessions of the same multi-week request; same progression_id entries don't penalize each other in anti-repetition (spec 17).

dominant_stimulus.description: The stimulus the user requested — MUST remain dominant (greatest time-in-zone + primary intent). Complementary stimuli are subordinate and may never displace it (spec 17 hard boundary). Zone is validated against the mode-appropriate enum via the top-level conditional rules — power and HR share zone names (e.g. 'Tempo') but are NEVER mixed (spec 4).

complementary_stimuli.description: Optional, engine-discovered, open-ended (NOT a fixed list — spec 17). Subordinate to the dominant stimulus. Used to break monotony while staying coherent with the requested objective.

rationale.description: Why this enrichment is methodologically coherent. May cite web-search-sourced reasoning (spec 9).

warmup.description: Mandatory (spec 11, v2.7). Designed per session by the reasoning layer: starts easy and builds; brief (~5 min) in short sessions, longer with duration and intensity; may carry short openers. Power mode may use ramps; HR mode climbing steps only. A user-requested length is used exactly.

main_set.description: The generated work (spec 11). Sequence of steps and/or non-nested repeat blocks.

cooldown.description: Mandatory (spec 11, v2.7). Designed per session: easy throughout and ending easy; brief in short sessions, longer after long or hard ones. A user-requested length is used exactly.

estimated_tss.description: DESIGN-TIME ESTIMATE of the rounded workout, not authoritative (spec 16.2/16.4). Real TSS is whatever intervals.icu/TrainingPeaks computes on upload.

feasibility.description: If the request could not be fully satisfied (e.g. TSS unreachable in max duration, intensity out of zone range), this records the conflict reported to the user — engine never silently forces a value (spec 16.3).

markdown_output.description: The complete .md file content in literal intervals.icu syntax (spec 12.1). Headers (# Warmup / # Main Set / # Cooldown) for organization; every line valid grammar; passes the output-validation gate (spec 12.3).

catalog_metadata.description: Descriptive, readable metadata recorded into the SQLite catalog (spec 17.1). MEMORY + reusable library entry, NOT a mechanical fingerprint for equality testing. Variety/progression come from the engine reasoning over the catalog plus physiology and web search (spec 17.2), never from comparing signatures.

summary.description: Human- and engine-readable one-line description of the session (e.g. 'Tempo 4x10min with short VO2 peaks').

allOf.description: Power-mode: all stimulus zones must be valid Friel power zones (spec 4.1). HR zones forbidden — the two systems are never mixed (spec 4).
HR-mode: all stimulus zones must be valid Friel HR zones (spec 4.2), LTHR-anchored.
